messages:
Ava (Finance): Heads up — payment hold on INV-2026-134 (Acme IL). We processed the run but withheld 30% withholding tax because the vendor's tax form didn't match the entity type in the vendor record. They claim a W-8BEN-E was submitted. Can Vendor Ops confirm?

Lina (Vendor Ops): Looking into it. Portal shows a W-8BEN-E uploaded 2025-11-02 but the entity type field looks like 'Disregarded entity' (possible mis-click). Acme IL is claiming they're a corporation. @Kfir can you confirm what you actually submitted?

Kfir (Vendor - Acme IL): Hi — I submitted the W-8BEN-E last year via the portal. We intended to indicate 'Corporation' but may have selected the wrong checkbox. I can re-upload a corrected W-8BEN-E today. The payment hold is blocking our cashflow — any way to expedite?

Marcus (Payments): FYI payment was scheduled but withheld. Payment ref: PAY-8872. We withheld net per tax rules. We can reprocess a refund/adjustment once we have a valid form, or consider a gross-up if the contract permits. Need Legal to confirm treaty/taxability.

Gal (Legal): Quick tax note: if Acme IL is a foreign corporation, the default US withholding is 30% on certain US-source fixed or determinable annual periodic payments unless a treaty applies. The US-Israel treaty reduces/waives withholding in some categories, but service income often still taxable. For treaty relief vendor must: complete the treaty claim on the W-8BEN-E, provide a foreign TIN (Israeli tax ID), and a valid signature date. Please ask vendor to fill Part III and include the foreign TIN.

Lina (Vendor Ops): Can we accept an amended upload and reprocess? @Marcus if they upload a corrected W-8BEN-E with a treaty claim, what's the path to refund and reissue?

Marcus (Payments): Once we have a validated corrected form we do: 1) mark form validated in vendor record, 2) reverse the withholding ledger entry, 3) issue a top-up payment (or vendor credit) for the withheld amount. Manual adjustment takes ~2-3 business days. If they need a gross-up now (i.e., we pay the withheld amount on top of gross), we need explicit approval from Finance + Legal and PO confirmation.

Kfir (Vendor - Acme IL): I'll upload the corrected W-8BEN-E now. Quick Q — Part III asks for 'U.S. TIN' — we don't have one. Is foreign TIN sufficient for treaty claim?

Gal (Legal): Foreign TIN (Israeli tax ID) in Part III is acceptable for treaty claims. The vendor must complete the treaty box and provide the foreign TIN. Also check signature date is recent (within our acceptance window). If no treaty claim is made, withholding stays.

Lina (Vendor Ops): Uploaded corrected W-8BEN-E and attached a screenshot in the portal. Link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/uploads/INV-2026-134/w8ben-e.pdf

paybot: Upload received: w8ben-e.pdf by Kfir at 2026-04-04 14:12 UTC

Marcus (Payments): Received the file and ran a quick validation. Part III filled, treaty claim indicated (country = Israel), foreign TIN present. Need Legal sign-off before doing refund reversal. @Gal pls confirm review.

Gal (Legal): Quick read looks ok. Signed date = 2026-03-30 (within acceptable window). Treaty claim language present and foreign TIN included. Approving refund/reverse withholding for INV-2026-134. Marcus — proceed to reverse withholding and schedule top-up payment. Please include memo: 'W-8 corrected — refund withholding'.

Marcus (Payments): :thumbsup: Will process. Refund/top-up scheduled for 2026-04-06. Reconciliation note: GL 6532 (tax withholding refunds). I'll post the payment trace once done.

Kfir (Vendor - Acme IL): Appreciate it, team. I'll confirm when the top-up hits our bank.

Ava (Finance): Thanks everyone. Action items: Lina — keep vendor thread updated. Marcus — post once adjustment done. Gal — flag if you later need copy to be retained in contract file.

Lina (Vendor Ops): Copy that — I'll update the portal note and close the ticket after payment confirmation.
